name: Hachioji City College Minami Osawa Cultural Hall
accessSummary: Minami-Osawa Station (Keio Sagamihara Line): 3 min walk
hours: 9:00-22:00 (Closed every Monday (the next day if it is a holiday) and Dec 29 - Jan 3)

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.note: 500 seats (496 fixed seats, 4 wheelchair spaces). Stage is 13.70 m wide, 11.00 m deep and 7.02 m high. Dressing rooms: 1 Japanese-style room and 3 Western-style rooms. Basic fee: 79,000 yen all day on weekdays, 95,000 yen all day on Saturdays, 100,000 yen all day on Sundays and holidays (time slots: morning 9:00-12:00 / afternoon 13:00-17:00 / evening 18:00-22:00).

rooms.name: Exchange Hall
rooms.note: Capacity 270 (the number of seats varies with the use). A circular space with a flat floor and a variable rising stage (4.50 m wide, 2.35 m deep, three height settings of 400, 600 and 800 mm). Basic fee: 44,000 yen all day on weekdays, 53,000 yen all day on Saturdays, 56,000 yen all day on Sundays and holidays.

rooms.name: Rehearsal Room
rooms.note: Capacity 76. Floor area excludes storage, anteroom, etc. Basic fee: 27,800 yen all day.

rooms.name: Practice Room 1
rooms.note: Capacity 21 (shared by Practice Rooms 1 and 2). Floor area includes storage and anteroom. Basic fee: 8,600 yen all day.

rooms.name: Practice Room 2
rooms.note: Capacity 21 (shared by Practice Rooms 1 and 2). Floor area includes storage and anteroom. Basic fee: 8,600 yen all day.

rooms.name: Exhibition / Multipurpose Room (Full)
rooms.note: Capacity 80. Floor area excludes waiting room, storage, etc. 22 movable panels, 20 folding tables, 80 folding chairs. Basic fee: 15,100 yen all day.

rooms.name: Exhibition / Multipurpose Room (Half)
rooms.note: Capacity 40. Floor area is about 80㎡. Basic fee: 7,550 yen all day.

rooms.name: Meeting Room 1
rooms.note: Capacity 36 (12 desks, 36 chairs). Basic fee: 4,200 yen all day.

rooms.name: Meeting Room 2
rooms.note: Capacity 36 (12 desks, 36 chairs). Basic fee: 4,200 yen all day.

rooms.name: Meeting Room 3
rooms.note: Capacity 27 (9 desks, 27 chairs). Basic fee: 3,700 yen all day.

rooms.name: Meeting Room 4
rooms.note: Capacity 18 (6 desks, 18 chairs). Basic fee: 3,100 yen all day.

rooms.name: Meeting Rooms 3 & 4
rooms.note: Capacity 63 (21 desks, 63 chairs). When Meeting Rooms 3 and 4 are used as one room, the fee is the sum of the fees for each (6,800 yen all day).

ops.prevDaySetup: Each usage slot (morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00, evening 18:00-22:00, all day 9:00-22:00) includes time from preparation to cleanup. When consecutive slots are used, the time between slots can also be used. The period of consecutive use is 6 days for the Main Hall, Exchange Hall and Exhibition / Multipurpose Room (exhibition purposes only), and 3 days for the Rehearsal Room, Practice Rooms, Meeting Rooms and Exhibition / Multipurpose Room (6 days when used in connection with the hall or exhibition room). Extending or advancing the usage time is approved for up to 1 hour only when it causes no problem for management, and an additional usage fee is charged. (Source: https://www.hachiojibunka.or.jp/minami/moushikomi/)
ops.loadingHours: To send packages to the venue in advance, submit the Package Delivery Notice 1 week before shipping (neither arrival nor pickup is possible on closed days). For merchandise sales, submit the Merchandise Sales Application / Settlement Form 2 weeks before the usage date. Even for exhibition room use, work is done through the loading entrance, and on the day follow the staff's instructions. (Source: https://www.hachiojibunka.or.jp/minami/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/★催物計画書★20260917～.pdf)
ops.parking: There is no dedicated parking lot; use the Hachioji City Minami-Osawa Parking Lot under the adjacent Fresco Minami-Osawa Building (100 spaces, 8:00-22:30, 120 yen per 30 minutes, vehicle limits: height 2.3 m, width 1.8 m, length 5 m) or a nearby paid parking lot. The cultural hall can be reached from the city parking lot by elevator. (Source: https://www.hachiojibunka.or.jp/minami/facility/parking/)
ops.waitingRooms: The Main Hall comes with dressing rooms (1 Japanese-style room and 3 Western-style rooms) and an organizer's waiting room. The Exchange Hall comes with a dressing room, a waiting room and a pantry. The Exhibition / Multipurpose Room comes with a waiting room. (Source: https://www.hachiojibunka.or.jp/minami/facility/main_hall/)
